item.title: Connection & Browser Check
item.description:
Everything on this page is either computed directly in your own browser, or read from information Cloudflare's network already sees for every request it handles. Nothing here is stored, logged, or sent anywhere beyond this one request — you're only seeing your own data, echoed back to you.

Prefer a terminal? curl https://green-rice-1ea7.denis-f21.workers.dev/api/ip returns just your IP as plain text — add ?family=v4 or ?family=v6 to check a specific version, or ?format=json for both fields together. Testing your *other* IP version (whichever one you're not currently connected over) needs a separate, protocol-only address — noted as a possible future addition rather than faked here.
